prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop web-app UI concept at 1440×1000 for the private social Teen Patti product shown in the two reference images. Reference Image 1 is the incumbent desktop welcome screen; Reference Image 2 is the incumbent mobile welcome screen. Preserve that established clubhouse identity exactly in spirit: near-black deep green page (#07110E), rich green felt (#163E2D), warm invitation gold (#E8B04A), warm ivory typography (#F6ECD8), dark lacquer brown rail (#2A1714), elegant high-contrast serif display headings paired with geometric sans-serif UI text, restrained soft shadows, tactile card-room materials, premium adult social atmosphere. Do not redesign the brand.

Direction: TWO-CHAIR BRIDGE. Design the authenticated lobby first viewport as two complementary halves: the host’s side on the left and the invited friend’s side on the right, connected by a central physical-looking room-code bridge and seat rail. The left side prominently says “Your table is ready” and shows a private table named “Sunday Circle”, room code “ACE-482”, “1 of 6 seated”, and a dominant gold “Share invite” action. The right side shows five tasteful empty friend-seat silhouettes around the shared rail with the message “Waiting for your people”. Keep navigation compact and quiet: Clubhouse, How to play, Profile. Include a small, clearly secondary “Practice & explore” disclosure near the lower edge, not a grid and not competing with the friend table. Emphasize that this is a private friends-only table. No public table browser, no purchase UI, no fake testimonials, no popularity claims, no real-money language, no casino neon, no gradients, no glassmorphism. Use realistic, crisp product copy and highly polished interaction affordances. The result should look like a credible board-ready web beta screenshot, not a moodboard, wireframe, poster, or marketing landing page.
